integrity: The proof reduces every zero constraint to the exact count of 2-labeled vertices outside its part, then partitions all feasible functions by the total number of 2-labels. A separate exhaustive checker tests the definition directly on all complete multipartite isomorphism types through order nine.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
Prior cograph algorithms already cover minimum-weight computation on a broader class.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed complete-multipartite enumerations.
title: Perfect Roman domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
